# ex: type wildcard substitution in applySubst
ex {
	type T int
	var x T
	x -> T(x)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type MyInt int

var X MyInt = 1
var Y MyInt = X
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,5 +2,5 @@

 type MyInt int

-var X MyInt = 1
-var Y MyInt = X
+var X MyInt = MyInt(1)
+var Y MyInt = MyInt(X)
